name.en: Building final and Certificate of Occupancy
name.zh: 建筑终验与入住许可证（CO）

agency.en: City of San Diego Development Services Department, Inspection Services
agency.zh: 圣地亚哥市开发服务局 检查服务处

when.en: After every trade inspection on the permit has passed. The County health final asks for your final or temporary Certificate of Occupancy first, so this comes before it.
when.zh: 许可证上所有工种检查通过之后。县卫生终验要求先出示正式或临时入住许可证，所以这一项排在卫生终验前面。

book.en: Schedule online in the DSD portal (sandiego.gov/DSDportal) with your permit or approval number, or on the 24/7 automated line 858-581-7111. To book with staff, call 858-581-7111 and press 0, 7 a.m.–3 p.m. on weekdays.
book.zh: 凭许可证号或审批号在开发服务局网上平台（sandiego.gov/DSDportal）预约，或拨打 24 小时自动预约专线 858-581-7111。如需人工预约，工作日早 7 点至下午 3 点拨打 858-581-7111 后按 0。

lead.en: Requests made by 10 p.m. are scheduled for the next business day. For a two-hour arrival window, call your assigned inspector by 8 a.m. on the day.
lead.zh: 晚上 10 点前提交的预约排在下一个工作日。如需两小时到达时段，当天早上 8 点前致电指派的检查员。

feeNote.en: Inspection fees are part of the permit fees (Information Bulletins 501, 506 and 103). A Temporary Certificate of Occupancy or a reissued certificate is $293.20 each.
feeNote.zh: 检查费含在许可证费用里（见信息公告 501、506、103）。临时入住许可证或补发入住许可证每份 293.20 美元。

failNext.en: You get a Correction Notice (DS-13); fix the work and keep it accessible until it passes. A re-inspection fee may be charged for incomplete work, uncorrected items, concealed work, no access, or a missing record card or plans, and no further inspections happen until it is paid. You can ask a supervisor for a second opinion.
failNext.zh: 检查员会开具整改通知（DS-13），整改完成前相关部位须保持可查验。若工程未完成、未按要求整改、未经检查就封闭、现场无法进入，或检查记录卡、批准图纸不在现场，可能收取复检费，缴清前不再安排检查。对结果有异议可申请主管复核。

item.en: An adult (18 or older) is on site to let the inspector in.
item.zh: 现场有一名年满 18 岁的成年人为检查员开门。

item.en: The approved plans are on site for the inspector.
item.zh: 批准图纸放在现场供检查员查阅。

item.en: The Inspection Record Card (DS-1798) is on site so the inspector can sign off.
item.zh: 检查记录卡（DS-1798）放在现场，供检查员签字确认。

item.en: Electrical panels and junction boxes are open and accessible; inspectors will not open them.
item.zh: 配电盘和接线盒已打开且便于查看，检查员不会自行拆开。

item.en: A completed Electrical Circuit Card (DS-1779) and the manufacturers' installation instructions are available.
item.zh: 已填好的电路卡（DS-1779）和各设备的厂家安装说明可供查阅。

item.en: Final summary special inspection reports, if your plans call for special inspections, have been emailed to DSD-Sp-Insp-Reports@sandiego.gov.
item.zh: 如图纸要求特殊检查，其最终汇总报告已发送至 DSD-Sp-Insp-Reports@sandiego.gov。

item.en: Areas to be inspected are lit, with a safe path of travel; an OSHA-approved ladder is set up if roof or attic access is needed.
item.zh: 待检区域照明充足、通道安全；如需上屋顶或进吊顶，已按职业安全规范架好合格梯子。

item.en: If the build-out occupies a shell or changes the occupancy classification, every inspection on every associated permit is approved, so the Certificate of Occupancy can issue.
item.zh: 若装修是首次进驻毛坯空间或改变了占用类别，所有关联许可证上的检查均已通过，入住许可证方可签发。

why.zh: 圣地亚哥市政法规 §129.0114；信息公告 585

name.en: Fire permit finals (kitchen hood, sprinklers, alarm)
name.zh: 消防许可终验（厨房排烟罩灭火、喷淋、火警）

agency.en: City of San Diego Development Services Department (fire permits, enforcing the San Diego Fire Code with San Diego Fire-Rescue)
agency.zh: 圣地亚哥市开发服务局（消防许可，与圣地亚哥消防救援局共同执行消防法规）

when.en: During construction, alongside the building inspections, and before the building final. Every kitchen hood suppression system, sprinkler change and fire alarm change needs its own fire permit and inspection.
when.zh: 施工期间与建筑检查同步进行，须在建筑终验之前完成。厨房排烟罩灭火系统、喷淋改动和火警系统改动都需要单独的消防许可和检查。

book.en: Book it the same way as the building inspections: in the DSD portal or on 858-581-7111, using the fire permit number.
book.zh: 预约方式与建筑检查相同：凭消防许可证号在开发服务局网上平台或拨打 858-581-7111 预约。

feeNote.en: Fire permit fees follow Information Bulletin 506. A monitored fire alarm also needs a separate San Diego Fire-Rescue alarm permit, $19 for 24 months.
feeNote.zh: 消防许可费按信息公告 506 收取。有监控的火警系统还需另向圣地亚哥消防救援局申请火警许可，24 个月 19 美元。

failNext.en: Correct and re-request. San Diego Fire-Rescue's new-construction reinspection fee is $327 (two-hour minimum).
failNext.zh: 整改后重新预约。圣地亚哥消防救援局新建工程复检费为 327 美元（最少按两小时计）。

item.en: The kitchen hood fire suppression system was installed under a DSD fire permit and passed its inspection.
item.zh: 厨房排烟罩灭火系统已凭开发服务局消防许可安装并通过检查。

item.en: Any sprinklers added or moved have passed a Fire Sprinkler Final, however few heads changed.
item.zh: 凡增加或移动了喷淋头，无论数量多少，都已通过喷淋终验。

item.en: Fire alarm work is permitted and inspected, and the monitored alarm has its Fire-Rescue alarm permit.
item.zh: 火警系统改动已获许可并通过检查，有监控的火警系统已办理消防救援局火警许可。

item.en: Address numbers are visible from the street.
item.zh: 门牌号从街上清晰可见。

item.en: A 2A:10BC extinguisher is within 75 feet of travel, mounted with its top no more than 5 feet above the floor, with a current State Fire Marshal tag.
item.zh: 75 英尺行走距离内配有 2A:10BC 灭火器，顶部离地不超过 5 英尺，挂有有效的州消防局年检标签。

item.en: Exit signs are illuminated, visible from any direction of travel, and have backup power.
item.zh: 出口标志有照明、从各疏散方向都看得见，并配有备用电源。

item.en: Exit doors open without a key or special knowledge, unlatch in one motion, and have no surface or flush bolts.
item.zh: 出口门无需钥匙或特殊操作即可打开，一个动作即可开锁，且无明插销或暗插销。

item.en: A Knox box is installed where access to the building is restricted.
item.zh: 如建筑出入受限，已安装消防钥匙箱（Knox Box）。

name.en: Food Facility Plan Check final inspection
name.zh: 食品设施图纸审查终验

agency.en: County of San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality (DEHQ), Food Plan Check
agency.zh: 圣地亚哥县环境卫生与质量局（DEHQ）食品图纸审查组

when.en: At 100% construction, after a required mid-construction inspection at 50–80% and after the city's final or temporary Certificate of Occupancy and fire approval. Apply for the health permit before scheduling it. Once it passes, the facility may operate.
when.zh: 施工 100% 完成时进行；此前须在 50%–80% 时通过一次施工中期检查，并已取得市政府的正式或临时入住许可证及消防批准。预约前先申请卫生许可证。终验通过后即可营业。

book.en: Call the plan checker named on your plan approval letter, or the Plan Check scheduling line at (858) 505-6660, to check the current lead time and book.
book.zh: 致电图纸批准函上注明的审图员，或拨打图纸审查预约专线 (858) 505-6660，了解当前排期并预约。

lead.en: Lead times vary; call early and book against the current lead time so your opening date doesn't slip.
lead.zh: 排期不固定，请尽早致电，按当前排期预约，以免耽误开业日期。

feeNote.en: The plan check fee covers review and inspections and is set by size: $1,534 (0–1,999 sq ft), $1,931 (2,000–5,999), $3,153 (6,000–9,999), $3,407 (10,000+). An expedited inspection is $588 (two-hour minimum). The annual health permit is separate (for example, $842 for a restaurant with 1–10 employees). Fee schedule effective July 10, 2026.
feeNote.zh: 图纸审查费含审图和检查，按面积收取：1,534 美元（0–1,999 平方英尺）、1,931 美元（2,000–5,999）、3,153 美元（6,000–9,999）、3,407 美元（10,000 以上）。加急检查 588 美元（最少按两小时计）。年度卫生许可证另计（例如 1–10 名员工的餐厅为 842 美元）。收费标准自 2026 年 7 月 10 日起生效。

failNext.en: Anything on the checklist that isn't done can block final approval or force you to reschedule the final inspection.
failNext.zh: 清单上任何一项未完成，都可能导致终验不予通过或需要重新预约。

item.en: All construction matches the DEHQ-approved plans.
item.zh: 所有施工与环境卫生与质量局批准的图纸一致。

item.en: You have a final or temporary Certificate of Occupancy from the building authority and fire department approval, if required.
item.zh: 已取得建筑主管部门的正式或临时入住许可证，以及（如需要）消防部门的批准。

item.en: A set of DEHQ-stamped approved plans is on site.
item.zh: 现场备有一套盖有环境卫生与质量局印章的批准图纸。

item.en: All approved equipment is in place, switches on and works properly.
item.zh: 所有批准的设备均已就位，能开机并正常运转。

item.en: Refrigerators hold 41°F or below with a working thermometer; freezers are at freezing temperatures.
item.zh: 冷藏设备温度在 41°F 或以下且配有有效温度计；冷冻设备保持冷冻温度。

item.en: 120°F hot water at every sink, and 100°F–108°F warm water at every hand sink.
item.zh: 所有水槽有 120°F 热水，所有洗手池有 100°F–108°F 温水。

item.en: Every hand sink has soap and paper towels in dispensers.
item.zh: 每个洗手池都配有分配器装的洗手液和擦手纸。

item.en: The warewashing sink has detergent, sanitizer and a way to test sanitizer strength.
item.zh: 洗碗槽备有洗涤剂、消毒剂和消毒液浓度测试工具。

item.en: Backflow devices are installed between the water supply and equipment, with certifications for testable devices.
item.zh: 供水与设备之间已安装防回流装置，可测试型装置备有合格证明。

item.en: The person in charge holds a valid Food Safety Certification.
item.zh: 现场负责人持有有效的食品安全认证。

item.en: Every employee has a San Diego County Food Handler card, or passed an in-house test within 10 days of hire.
item.zh: 所有员工持有圣地亚哥县食品从业人员卡，或在入职 10 天内通过了店内考核。

item.en: The facility is clean and free of vermin.
item.zh: 店内整洁，无虫鼠。

name.en: Routine food inspection and A/B/C grade card
name.zh: 例行食品检查与 A/B/C 等级卡

agency.en: County of San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality (DEHQ), Food and Housing Division
agency.zh: 圣地亚哥县环境卫生与质量局（DEHQ）食品与住房处

when.en: Unannounced, after you open, at a frequency set by the facility's risk. Kept up for as long as you operate.
when.zh: 开业后不定期突击检查，频率按店铺风险等级确定，营业期间持续进行。

book.en: You don't book routine inspections. After a B or C you can pay the unscheduled inspection fee and request a re-grade inspection.
book.zh: 例行检查无需预约。拿到 B 或 C 后，可缴纳非例行检查费并申请重新评级检查。

feeNote.en: There is no charge per routine visit; it is covered by the annual health permit, which is set by facility type and staff size (for example $842 for a restaurant with 1–10 employees, $587 for a low-risk facility, $255 for a prepackaged retail market).
feeNote.zh: 例行检查不单独收费，含在年度卫生许可证费中；许可证费按店铺类型和员工人数确定（例如 1–10 名员工的餐厅 842 美元，低风险设施 587 美元，预包装零售店 255 美元）。

scoring.en: Points are subtracted from 100: 4 for a major risk factor, 2 for a minor one, 1 for a good retail practice. A is 90–100, B is 80–89, and C is 79 or below, a failing grade. The grade card must be posted near the public entrance during all hours of operation.
scoring.zh: 从 100 分中扣分：重大风险因素扣 4 分，次要风险因素扣 2 分，良好零售规范扣 1 分。90–100 分为 A，80–89 分为 B，79 分及以下为 C（不合格）。营业期间等级卡必须张贴在顾客入口附近。

failNext.en: A B or C comes with an Official Notice of Violation and correction deadlines, and you must earn an A within 30 days or face further enforcement. A re-grade needs the unscheduled inspection fee paid first (billed at the $197 hourly rate). An imminent hazard such as a sewage backup, no hot water, vermin or a long power outage closes the facility until DEHQ authorizes reopening in writing.
failNext.zh: 得到 B 或 C 会同时收到正式违规通知及整改期限，须在 30 天内重新拿到 A，否则将面临进一步执法。申请重新评级须先缴纳非例行检查费（按每小时 197 美元计）。若出现污水倒灌、无热水、虫鼠或长时间停电等紧急危害，店铺将被勒令停业，须经环境卫生与质量局书面批准方可重新营业。

item.en: Food comes from approved, licensed sources and is free of contamination and spoilage.
item.zh: 食品来自经批准的持证来源，无污染、无变质。

item.en: Potentially hazardous foods are held below 41°F or above 135°F.
item.zh: 潜在危害食品保存在 41°F 以下或 135°F 以上。

item.en: Each refrigerator has a thermometer accurate to ±2°F, and a metal probe thermometer is on hand and used.
item.zh: 每台冷藏设备配有精度 ±2°F 的温度计，并备有金属探针温度计且实际使用。

item.en: Food is thawed only in the refrigerator, under cold running water, in the microwave, or as part of cooking.
item.zh: 食品只在冷藏柜内、流动冷水下、微波炉中或烹饪过程中解冻。

item.en: Food is stored at least 6 inches off the floor, covered, labeled, and with raw kept apart from cooked.
item.zh: 食品离地至少 6 英寸存放，加盖并贴标签，生熟分开。

item.en: Everyone handling unpackaged food or utensils has a Food Handler card, with records on hand.
item.zh: 所有接触散装食品或餐具的员工持有食品从业人员卡，记录随时可查。

item.en: Staff wash hands with soap and warm water for at least 20 seconds before work, after the restroom and between tasks.
item.zh: 员工上班前、如厕后及换工序时用洗手液和温水洗手至少 20 秒。

item.en: No one with open sores or illness handles food; hair is restrained and outer garments are clean.
item.zh: 有伤口或生病的员工不接触食品；员工束好头发，外衣干净。

item.en: Utensils are washed, rinsed and sanitized in a three-compartment sink or an approved dish machine, with test strips on hand.
item.zh: 餐具在三格水槽或认证洗碗机中洗涤、冲洗、消毒，并备有测试试纸。

item.en: Hand sinks work, have soap and towel dispensers filled, and have handwashing signs posted.
item.zh: 洗手池可正常使用，洗手液和擦手纸分配器装满，并张贴洗手标识。

item.en: All sinks have hot and cold water under pressure and drain properly; backflow devices are in good repair.
item.zh: 所有水槽有压力冷热水且排水通畅；防回流装置完好。

item.en: No insects or rodents; outside doors are self-closing and air curtains work.
item.zh: 无虫鼠；外门能自动关闭，风幕机运转正常。

item.en: Cleaning chemicals are labeled and stored away from food.
item.zh: 清洁化学品贴有标签，与食品分开存放。

item.en: The health permit and grade card are posted, along with no-smoking and choking first-aid signs.
item.zh: 卫生许可证和等级卡已张贴，并张贴禁烟及噎食急救标识。

agency.en: San Diego Fire-Rescue Department, Community Risk Reduction Division
agency.zh: 圣地亚哥消防救援局 社区风险降低处

when.en: After you open. Places where more than 49 people gather (most sit-down restaurants of that size) are inspected every year; other businesses are inspected on Fire-Rescue's schedule or after a complaint.
when.zh: 开业之后。可容纳 49 人以上的场所（多数这一规模的堂食餐厅）每年检查一次；其他商户按消防救援局安排或在接到投诉后检查。

book.en: Fire-Rescue schedules it; you don't book it. For questions, call the regional advisor at 619-533-4388.
book.zh: 由消防救援局安排，无需预约。如有疑问，请拨打区域顾问电话 619-533-4388。

feeNote.en: Billed by floor area (FY2026 schedule): $299 up to 5,000 sq ft, $374 for 5,001–10,000, $448 for 10,001–12,000, $598 for 12,001–50,000. The invoice comes by mail after the inspection.

failNext.en: Correct by the reinspection. Non-compliance penalties start at the third visit: $300, then $600 at the fourth, and $1,200 at the fifth and later visits.
failNext.zh: 须在复检前整改完毕。从第三次上门起收取违规罚款：第三次 300 美元，第四次 600 美元，第五次及以后每次 1,200 美元。

item.en: Exit paths are free of obstructions and storage; exit doors open without a key.
item.zh: 疏散通道无障碍、无堆放物品；出口门无需钥匙即可打开。

item.en: Exit signs and emergency lighting work and have backup power.
item.zh: 出口标志和应急照明工作正常，并有备用电源。

item.en: Extinguishers (minimum 2A:10BC) are mounted, within 75 feet of travel, and carry a current annual State Fire Marshal tag.
item.zh: 灭火器（至少 2A:10BC）已挂墙安装，行走距离不超过 75 英尺，并有当年州消防局年检标签。

item.en: Storage stays at least 18 inches below sprinkler heads (2 feet below the ceiling if unsprinklered) and out of electrical and mechanical rooms.
item.zh: 堆放物品距喷淋头至少 18 英寸（无喷淋时距天花板至少 2 英尺），且不放在配电间和机房内。

item.en: Extension cords are not used in place of permanent wiring or run through walls or ceilings.
item.zh: 不用延长线代替固定布线，也不穿墙或穿天花板。

item.en: There is a clear space 36 inches deep and 78 inches high in front of electrical panels, and breakers are labeled.
item.zh: 配电盘前留有 36 英寸深、78 英寸高的净空，断路器均有标识。

item.en: Sprinkler heads aren't painted, corroded or obstructed, and the riser carries a current 5-year certification tag.
item.zh: 喷淋头未被涂漆、未锈蚀、无遮挡，立管挂有有效的五年检测标签。

item.en: The fire alarm panel shows normal (green) and its inspection, testing and maintenance records are kept on site.
item.zh: 火警控制面板显示正常（绿灯），检查、测试和维护记录存放在现场。

item.en: Dumpsters over 1.5 cubic yards sit at least 5 feet from combustible walls, openings and eaves.
item.zh: 容量超过 1.5 立方码的垃圾箱距可燃墙面、门窗洞口和屋檐至少 5 英尺。

item.en: Address numbers are visible from the street, and the Knox box keys are current.
item.zh: 门牌号从街上可见，消防钥匙箱内的钥匙为最新。
